title: ChatAreaComposer: toolbar button correctness + UX polish
description: Fix 5 issues in ChatAreaComposer.tsx introduced by Phase 1: conditional render on BookmarkPlus button, missing focus-visible on 3 new buttons, copy feedback state, Trash2 layout-shift transition, and prop rename.
action: Apply 5 surgical fixes to src/components/ChatAreaComposer.tsx: (1) Add 'useState' import from 'react'. (2) Add 'Check' to lucide-react imports. (3) Rename prop 'onOpenKnowledgePanel' → 'onToggleKnowledgePanel' in interface and destructure. (4) Add 'const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false)' at top of component body. (5) Update copyLastReply to: navigator.clipboard?.writeText(lastAssistantContent).then(() => { setCopied(true); setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1500) }).catch(() => {}). (6) Wrap BookmarkPlus button in: {onToggleKnowledgePanel && (...)}. (7) Add focus-visible classes to all 3 new buttons: append 'focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary-500/50' to their className. (8) Replace Trash2 conditional mount {input.length > 0 && onClearDraft && (<button>)} with always-rendered button: className includes 'transition-opacity' plus conditional 'opacity-0 pointer-events-none' when !input.length or !onClearDraft. (9) Replace Copy <Copy size={15}/> with conditional icon: {copied ? <Check size={15} className='text-green-500' /> : <Copy size={15} />}. (10) Update Copy button aria-label to {copied ? 'copied!' : 'copy last reply'}.

files.change: Add useState, Check imports; rename onOpenKnowledgePanel→onToggleKnowledgePanel; add copied state; update copyLastReply; fix BookmarkPlus conditional; add focus-visible to 3 buttons; replace Trash2 conditional mount with opacity transition; add copy feedback icon

implementation: Update import line 1: change 'import type { RefObject } from \'react\'' to 'import { useState } from \'react\'; import type { RefObject } from \'react\''
Update import line 2: add 'Check' to lucide-react imports: 'import { BookmarkPlus, Check, Copy, MicOff, Paperclip, Send, Square, Trash2 } from \'lucide-react\''
In ChatAreaComposerProps interface: rename 'onOpenKnowledgePanel?: () => void' to 'onToggleKnowledgePanel?: () => void'
At top of component body (after destructure, before return): add 'const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false)'

Replace copyLastReply function with: const copyLastReply = () => { navigator.clipboard?.writeText(lastAssistantContent!).then(() => { setCopied(true); setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1500) }).catch(() => {}) }

Wrap the BookmarkPlus button (lines ~96-104) in: {onToggleKnowledgePanel && (<button onClick={onToggleKnowledgePanel} aria-label='open knowledge panel' title='open knowledge panel' className='rounded-lg p-1.5 text-gray-400 transition-colors hover:bg-gray-100 hover:text-gray-600 dark:hover:bg-dark-bg dark:hover:text-dark-text focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary-500/50' type='button'><BookmarkPlus size={15} /></button>)}

Replace the Trash2 conditional block {input.length > 0 && onClearDraft && (<button...>)} with always-rendered: <button onClick={onClearDraft} aria-label='clear draft' title='clear draft' className={`rounded-lg p-1.5 text-gray-400 transition-all hover:bg-gray-100 hover:text-gray-600 dark:hover:bg-dark-bg dark:hover:text-dark-text focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary-500/50 ${(!input.length || !onClearDraft) ? 'opacity-0 pointer-events-none' : ''}`} type='button'><Trash2 size={15} /></button>

Replace the Copy conditional block {lastAssistantContent && (<button...><Copy/></button>)} with: {lastAssistantContent && (<button onClick={copyLastReply} aria-label={copied ? 'copied!' : 'copy last reply'} title='copy last reply' className='rounded-lg p-1.5 text-gray-400 transition-colors hover:bg-gray-100 hover:text-gray-600 dark:hover:bg-dark-bg dark:hover:text-dark-text focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary-500/50' type='button'>{copied ? <Check size={15} className='text-green-500' /> : <Copy size={15} />}</button>)}

criteria: src/components/ChatAreaComposer.tsx contains 'focus-visible:ring-2' at least 3 times (one per new button)
convergence.definition_of_done: BookmarkPlus only renders when prop provided; all 3 new buttons have focus rings; Trash2 fades instead of popping; Copy button shows checkmark after success; prop renamed consistently.

unit: existing toolbar button tests should pass after prop rename fix in test file

rationale.chosen_approach: Single-file surgical fix with no new abstractions. All 5 issues are localized to ChatAreaComposer.tsx.
decision_factors: No test changes needed in Wave 1 (TASK-004 handles tests)
rationale.tradeoffs: Trash2 uses opacity approach (renders always, hides visually) to avoid layout shift — slightly increases DOM; trade-off is acceptable.
